channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joel Embiid | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joel Embiid from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Olden Polynice on how he would react if he was Joel Embiid and LeBron James walks into the locker room and starts setting standards:

“I’ll be like, you ain’t my daddy. You ain’t my daddy you my teammate, you know. You have to respect. Again, the man doesn’t walk on water. I will give you the respect, but that’s about it. You’re still not going to come in and just like dictate stuff. You know, first of all look, the man plays for the 76ers and he’s jumping on helicopters every day going to New York. It’s like how are you spending time with your teammates getting to know them outside of practice, which is something you should be trying to do.”

Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Oct 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid’s offensive role:

“We are trying to move him around the floor a little more frequently this season.”

Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid, Oct 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Dean Wade on the high basketball IQ of new 76ers teammates:

“It is completely different. You know their tendencies playing against them, but when you are on the same team, you can pick their brain. My biggest thing is the way they think the game is the most impressive thing. Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, everyone, the way they think the game is at such a high level. As an NBA player, you think you know the game well, and then you get on a team like this and it is night and day. You see the way they think about plays, think about defenses, the way they think about rotations. It is similar to some things I thought, but they go a little more in-depth and it is super impressive.”

Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Nurse on LeBron James, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Ausin Krell:Nick Nurse:

“[Embiid] and LeBron have both been a part of everything we've done. I will say they're both pretty smart about when we're scrimmaging and run 7 or 8 plays, they're getting themselves in and out. I think they're not overdoing it. But, yes, they want to get in shape, get the chemistry, feel.”

Nick Nurse on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Oct 1, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Tyrese Maxey:Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid:

“He looks great. He looks amazing. He looks happy. When you're healthy and you're happy, you're at peace with your life in basketball. That's when your best.”

Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid
item.description:
“I mean, I'm getting older ... and I just feel like I've been here for a minute. Process [Embiid] has been here, I think what, 13 years? I've been here seven. So, we've been here for a while, kind of know how things go around here and just am trying to keep using my voice and help everybody get familiar and help everybody get comfortable.”

Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid, Sep 30, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Derek Bodner:LeBron James, on Joel Embiid:

“Jo is one of the most talented guys that we have in the world,and obviously we all know for him it's just been about health... I've seen him put in a lot of work on his body, a lot of work on his game, a lot of work on his mental this offseason.”

LeBron James on Joel Embiid, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Johnson emphasized that LeBron’s influence extends far beyond mere distribution on the stat sheet, highlighting his innate ability to unify elite talent.

“When you think about Maxey, Embiid… all those guys, now Jaylen Brown,”

Magic Johnson on Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 21, 2026. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Mike Gansey on LeBron James, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Sixers president Mike Gansey on Joel Embiid fitting in with LBJ:

“When LeBron was maybe a possibility, I went back and watched some of the Olympic tape with him and LeBron. Those two played pretty well together. We have so many different options. Any given night anyone can be the guy. So I think once we get clicking and get gelling, it's gonna be fun to watch”

Mike Gansey on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Aug 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
“Just being a rookie and being able to be around all those guys is a privilege for me. You don’t get to see a rookie get to play with five guys that can potentially make an All-Star team [James, Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, and VJ Edgecombe]. I feel like you can learn every day, and every day you can compete against them to get better.”

Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Aug 3, 2026. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“Joel Embiid is going to dominate this year. You heard it here first. Joel Embiid will be titled as the best big man in the league. He's passing up the Joker this year. He's going to work this year.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Joel Embiid, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Managing Partner Josh Harris said.

“I cannot wait to see LeBron alongside Jaylen Brown, VJ Edgecombe, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and our talented roster as we work to deliver a championship for Philly. To LeBron and his family: we are grateful you chose the 76ers, and look forward to this next chapter of your legendary career. Welcome to the 76ers!”

Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 27, 2026. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“It's time for them to part ways, a mutual thing. I think it's best for Joel Embiid to go see what another organization has to offer. I think it's best for Joel Embiid to go witness and see what another medical staff is like. Maybe under somebody else, maybe their medical staff might be better than the 76ers' medical staff. We've seen a lot of stories where guys left certain organizations, and all of a sudden you're like, who the f*** is that?”

Kendrick Perkins on Joel Embiid, May 16, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Harris on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Josh Harris on Joel Embiid:

“I think putting all of the focus on one player is the wrong place to be.”

Josh Harris on Joel Embiid, May 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Nick Nurse, on Joel Embiid:

“He worked his ass off to get out there and play. I think it was really difficult for him, especially [in Game 3].He gave us everything he could. I commend him.”

Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid, May 10, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Derek Bodner:VJ Edgecombe, on Joel Embiid's praise:

“I really love my teammates and I really love all the good things they say about me, but I gotta put in the work to continue getting betterso what they say can come to pass.'”

VJ Edgecombe on Joel Embiid, May 10, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Draymond Green on Joel Embiid
item.description:
“I don’t like stuff like that. There’s no way a guy of Joel Embiid’s stature can have a legacy game in Round 1 and he still hasn’t accomplished, ultimately, what he wants to accomplish.”

Draymond Green on Joel Embiid, May 5, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Green said he believes the people stating that it was a legacy performance are the same ones who will be ready to blame Embiid if the 76ers fail to reach the conference championship – somewhere Embiid has never been since entering the league in 2014.

“I hate when people try to set guys up like, ‘Aw man, this is a legacy game for Joel Embiid,’ only to set him up to try to tear him down in the weeks to come,”

Draymond Green on Joel Embiid, May 5, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Joel Embiid
item.description:
for Embiid, who has now reached the Eastern Conference semifinals for the sixth time in his career.

“I know a lot of people are saying, ‘Yo, is this a legacy game for Joel Embiid?’ and I say no, 'hell no,'”

Draymond Green on Joel Embiid, May 5, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“But he came and did what he was supposed to do. He dominated, and we lost. So, credit to the 76ers, credit to Joel Embiid. I still think he flopped entirely way too much. Some of y’all don’t even know what flopping is in the chat. Like, some of y’all clearly don’t know basketball. Y’all don’t know what flopping is. Flopping is exaggerating contact that’s already there. It’s not about drawing contact or drawing fouls. Nobody has a problem with drawing fouls. That’s a part of the game. Use your brains. That’s the thing about this basketball era where y’all have turned your brains off and just look at analytics. I have no idea what y’all talking about. Drawing fouls is fine.”

Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid, May 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“That’s how you know people be watching my stream. That’s how you know Joel Embiid was sitting there at home, eating chocolate chip cookies, watching my stream, and he was like, ‘You know what? When I come back, I’m going to show these guys.’Because I ain’t never seen him that dominant. He was dominant from a physical standpoint, passing the ball. Obviously, he’s been more athletic in the past, but I give him credit. He came out, and he made a difference in this series. No question.”

Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid, May 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“You know what I mean? This is my personal opinion on basketball. Some of y’all might disagree, but argue with your grandma. Flopping has ruined our game. Joel Embiid is a great player, one of the best bigs in basketball history. Flops. He knows it. This ain’t breaking news. That’s just my opinion. I’m not the only one that had that opinion. Some of y’all are going to be mad about that opinion. Some of y’all can kiss my ass.”

Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid, May 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid:

“He's a big body. He also was flopping around. He got some extra calls and stuff like that and they rewarded him for that. But that's the league that we're in”

Jaylen Brown on Joel Embiid, May 3, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid
item.description:
#Sixers coach Nick Nurse on what unlocked for Joel Embiid:

“It was a little similar to the other night that obviously he was getting some good looks, and a lot of them were just going in and out…Iwas sitting there thinking, he's not far away here from finding some rhythm.”

Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid, Apr 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid, who missed the last two games before the All-Star break with a right knee issue:

“He was out there [today at practice], looked pretty good. He’s got a meeting shortly… so we’ll know a little bit more about where he is.”

Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid, Feb 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid:

“He's really good at basketball. He played more minutes than me to tonight so that's good”

Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid, Jan 31, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
‪Erin Grugan: Former Sixers' player Furkan Korkmaz said back in Sept. 2025:

“Until now I thought Joel Embiid was the best player, best center I was playing with, but I think we can tell it's Alperen Sengun now”

Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun, Jan 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Joel Embiid
item.description:
Kyle Lowry on Joel Embiid:

“I'm holding him accountable. Honestly, he's holding himself accountable. He's an unbelievable person. I think he's bought in. The injuries take tolls on us. I think that took a lot of toll on him. Everything that people say about him...he's all in”

Kyle Lowry on Joel Embiid, Oct 25, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
“I think Joel Embiid was the best player, best center I was playing with, but I think we can tell that it's Alperen [Sengun] now,”

Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun, Sep 9, 2025. Source: BasketNews.
